summary: The central-bracket exponential subgroup and the Geck single-bond relation are new and reuse the existing class-two divided-power and exponential lemmas. However, the PR adds two public lemmas that only restate `commutatorElement_kostantRootSubgroupParam_eq_bracket`, plus a pair of near-identical private transport proofs in the Geck file.
